description:
The unsigned calldata to post `shares` fund shares (a decimal or 'all' of the wallet) as collateral: approve to Blue (when the
        allowance is short) + supplyCollateral(marketParams, shares, account, 0x), with the position before and after (HF, LTV). No
        oracle read. insufficient_balance when the wallet holds fewer shares (shares still in the fund's redemption queue do not count).
        You send it with the account's own owner key; this server never sends.
name: borrow_supply_collateral_quote
